source: Robinhood MCP get_equity_historicals, weekly bars, split-adjusted
requested_end_note: through most recent available week as of fetch time (2026-08-31)
ticker_universe: union of all tickers appearing across the 14 SPMO NPORT-P holdings snapshots (spmo_holdings_history.json), 478 tickers after normalizing renamed companies to current ticker
missing_tickers_note: These symbols returned 'inactive_instruments' or 'missing_instruments' errors from Robinhood's historicals API on repeated attempts. Some are genuinely delisted/acquired (ABMD, ANSS, ATVI, CERN, CTLT, CTXS, DFS, DRE, FLT, FRC, HES, IPG, JNPR, KSU, MRO, PXD, SIVB, TWTR, XLNX). A subset are still actively-traded large caps (AVB, BK, CMA, CTRA, EA, EQR, HOLX, K, MMC, SEE) that nonetheless came back unavailable from this API/account on multiple retries -- treat as a data-source gap, not a real absence of trading history.
